De Moivre's Theorem states that

$$
[\operatorname{cos}⁡(\phi )+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\phi )]^{n}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(n\phi )+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(n\phi ).
$$

In our expression, we have $n=11$ and $\phi =\theta .$ Substituting in these values, we get

$$
[\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta +\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡\theta ]^{11}=\operatorname{cos}⁡(11\theta )+\text{i}\operatorname{sin}⁡(11\theta ).
$$
